resources.string: In mouse mode, ignore tiny movements of a resting finger so the cursor doesn\'t jump when streaming a high-resolution host (real swipes keep full sensitivity)
Start filtering jitter after the finger has rested this long. Lower filters sooner; higher keeps swipe starts more responsive
The finger must leave this range before it counts as moving; it also defines taps and long presses. Raise it for high-resolution hosts or a shaky finger, lower it for more sensitivity
